then.text: You found the pearls. Most people stop at the cathedral and ask where the toilets are. Respect.
Mind the steps on the way out. I say it forty times a day and I have yet to be believed.
Barrier's up. Through to the river first. It floods, and there's a weir board on the far bank to drain it, if you can reach it. Or wade, if somebody's taught you how.

Bring a lantern. Some things in this cave only show in proper light. Then it's the Cathedral Cave: a block to push onto a plate. Straight lines. If you jam it in a corner, step out and come back in. The cave tidies itself.

else.text: Welcome to Dan yr Ogof. That's 'under the cave' in Welsh, which is not a mystery, only a description.
The barrier is locked from my side. The handle by the desk works it. Give it a proper pull. It's been pulled by worse.
